say:0:1411433101:0.text: Ah, they walk so fast. Magister, this way!
say:0:1411433101:0.source_cn: 他们走得真快，主人，往这边！
say:0:1411433101:0.male: Ah, they walk so fast. Magister, this way!
say:0:1411433101:0.female: Ah, they walk so fast. Magister, this way!

say:1:1411433102:0.text: It seems that once Baelran has a goal, he becomes a different person.
say:1:1411433102:0.source_cn: 一旦有了目标，巴赫朗也比之前有干劲了。
say:1:1411433102:0.male: It seems that once Baelran has a goal, he becomes a different person.
say:1:1411433102:0.female: It seems that once Baelran has a goal, he becomes a different person.
